title: How to Design Impenetrable Airport Security
summary: A Wendover Productions explainer on how airport security is designed, covering screening layers, x-ray scanning, and the contrast with Israel's profiling-based approach. It walks through the logic behind why security works the way it does.
why: HN commenters point to it as a well-researched primer when airport security theatre and Israeli-style screening come up.

quote.text: If you actually want to be informed on the subject I highly recommend
